1 रुज् रुज॑ति pp. रुग्ण॑ (q.v.) break, crush down,
destroy;
 pain, afflict. C. रोजयति give one a blow upon (loc.).
—अव break off. आ break open or asunder, tear out, lacerate, dislimb.
प्र break to pieces. वि & सम् break, crush, rend.

2 रुज् a. breaking, crushing;
 f. grief, sorrow, pain, illness.

रुज॑ a. = prec. adj.;
 f. रुजा breaking, pain.
रुजाय् pp. रुजायमान causing pain, aching.*
